description: Get sunrise, sunset, first and last light, golden hour, moonrise, moonset and moon phase for any place on Earth, for one day or up to two weeks, plus the next new, quarter and full moons. Use for "what time is sunset in …", "when is golden hour", "moon phase tonight", "next full moon". Works worldwide from latitude + longitude (add time_zone outside the US); a US coastal place name or station_id also works.

date.description: Local calendar date at the place, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today there.

days.description: How many consecutive local days to return, 1–14.

latitude.description: Latitude of the place being asked about, decimal degrees. Use with longitude when a place name is not recognised; approximate is fine.

longitude.description: Longitude of the place, decimal degrees (negative west).

place.description: The coastal place being asked about — a beach, harbor, bay, or town, optionally with a state: "Santa Cruz, CA".

station_id.description: 7-digit NOAA tide station ID, when already known from an earlier result.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone for the place, e.g. "Europe/Lisbon". Recommended for coordinates outside the US; inferred when omitted.

name: perigee_get_sun_moon

perigee.description: perigeetides.com page for the same answer; share it.

summary.description: One or two sentences that answer the question directly.
